fact: Car 87 left the track in Turn 12 while defending to Car 12 and maintained his position by doing so.
offence: Breach of Article 33.3 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards reviewed video evidence. Car 12 was attempting an overtake on Car 87 on the inside into Turn 12 and had its front axle ahead of the mirrors of Car 87 prior to and at the apex. Therefore Car 12 had the right to use the full width of the track. Car 87 left the track on the outside while defending and rejoined the track in front of Car 12. The Stewards determine that Car 12 attempted a legitimate overtake, earned the right to the racing line according to the Driving Standard Guidelines and did not deliberately force Car 87 off track, whereas Car 87 gained a lasting advantage from leaving the track by maintaining its position.
rules_referenced: Article 33.3 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 87 Leaving The Track And Gaining An Advantage
